modalities.name: coords
modalities.origin: GBIF occurrence lat/lon from gbif_tokens/*.npz (built by data/deepcal/build_plant.py); elevation from gbif_elev.npz; event time from gbif_eventtime.npz sidecar or observations_meta.parquet
modalities.notes: columns = [lat_deg, lon_deg, elev_m, tnorm]; tnorm is 0 unless time_axis=True

modalities.name: vision_dino
modalities.origin: DINOv2 pooled embedding of the GBIF/iNaturalist ground photo; stored as 'dino' in gbif_tokens/chunk*.npz; builder build_plant.py; L2-normalized on load
modalities.notes: occurrence-only obs have zeroed rows; presence tracked by derived mask has_vision = (|dino|.sum > 1e-6)

modalities.name: vision_bio
modalities.origin: BioCLIP image embedding of the same ground photo; 'bio' in gbif_tokens/chunk*.npz; builder build_plant.py; L2-normalized on load

modalities.name: identity (cls)
modalities.origin: 'species_local' in gbif_tokens/*.npz; species vocab (4628 classes) from gbif_vocab.npz + derived/species_index.csv; builder build_plant.py
modalities.notes: categorical species id; binomial names in vocab['binomial']

modalities.name: phylo
modalities.origin: evolutionary-position vector E1 in gbif_vocab.npz (phylogenomic embedding; dated tree ca_subtree.dated.nwk, plant_dated_patristic.R); L2-normalized

modalities.name: traits (8 categorical heads: plant_type, growth_rate, seasonality, sun, water, soil_drainage, ease_of_care, form)
modalities.shape: [n_classes, 8]; per head class counts from catvocab_* (7/5/5/3/5/5/3/9)
modalities.origin: derived/traits_syn.npz (Calscape-style horticultural traits, synthesized/expanded); indexed per-obs through cls

modalities.name: climate
modalities.origin: Daymet daily weather; gbif_daymet_tokens/chunk*.npz (77 chunks), builder env_priors/build_daymet.py; z-scored per channel on train rows only

modalities.name: naip_rgb
modalities.origin: NAIP aerial RGB patch embedded with DINOv3-SAT493M; 'rgb_pool' in gbif_naip_tokens/chunk*.npz (51 chunks), builder env_priors/build_naip.py; row-unit-normalized

modalities.name: naip_ir
modalities.origin: NAIP infrared patch, DINOv3-SAT493M 'ir_pool' in gbif_naip_tokens/chunk*.npz; env_priors/build_naip.py; row-unit-normalized

modalities.name: clay
modalities.origin: Clay v1.5 foundation-model embedding of Sentinel-2 scene; gbif_clay_tokens.npz, builder env_priors/build_clay.py; row-unit-normalized; validity 'has_clay'

modalities.name: soil
modalities.origin: SSURGO soil properties; gbif_soil_tokens.npz (property_names inside), builder env_priors/build_soil.py; train-only z-score; validity 'has_soil'

modalities.name: topo
modalities.origin: USGS 3DEP 1 m microtopography features; gbif_topo_tokens.npz, builder env_priors/build_topo.py; train-only z-score; validity 'has_topo'

modalities.name: chm
modalities.origin: NAIP-derived canopy height model 0.6 m canopy+structure features; gbif_chm_tokens.npz, builder env_priors/build_chm.py; train-only z-score; validity 'has_chm'

modalities.name: hydro
modalities.origin: HydroSHEDS-style drainage + Winstral wind exposure; gbif_hydro_tokens.npz, builder env_priors/build_hydrowind.py; train-only z-score; validity 'has_hydro'

modalities.name: worldclim / phenology / alphaearth
modalities.origin: WorldClim v2.1 bioclim, NOAA-CDR VIIRS NDVI, Google AlphaEarth Satellite Embedding V1 — supported by _load_modalities but their token files (gbif_worldclim_tokens.npz etc.) are NOT present in this cache dir, so not loaded here

modalities.name: species_text
modalities.origin: bioclip_taxon_text_emb.npy — frozen BioCLIP-2 taxonomic-string text embeddings in vocab order (code comment says 768 but file is 1024-d)

modalities.name: pollinator distribution (poll_idx/poll_frq/poll_valid)
modalities.origin: GloBI plant-pollinator interactions; gbif_pollinator_dist.npz + pollinator_animal_mask.npy + pollinator_taxon_text_emb.npy [7373, 1024]; builder build_pollinator.py
modalities.notes: indexed per-obs through cls in batch() as _poll_*

modalities.name: lfmc / lfmc_valid
modalities.origin: gbif_lfmc.npz — per-species peak fire-season live fuel moisture (B34)

modalities.name: myco / myco_valid
modalities.origin: gbif_mycorrhiza.npz — FungalRoot genus-level mycorrhizal symbiosis type (B42)

modalities.name: flower / flower_valid
modalities.origin: gbif_flower_all.npz (35805 labeled gbifIDs; PhenoVision/iNat flowering annotations, B26), joined to observations by gbifID; plus derived species_peak_month [n_classes]

modalities.name: gbifID
modalities.origin: GBIF occurrence id from gbif_tokens/*.npz

modalities.name: obs_month / month_tnorm
modalities.origin: derived from event dates (gbif_eventtime.npz or observations_meta.parquet) when time_axis=True (B28)

split.spatial: Whole 0.5-degree lat/lon cells held out: cell key = floor(lat/0.5)*10007 + floor(lon/0.5); unique cells shuffled with np.random.default_rng(0) (seed 0); first max(1, int(n_cells * holdout_fraction)) cells become test; every observation in a held-out cell is test, rest train. Default holdout_fraction = 1/6.

alternatives.phylo: whole plant families held out (shuffled with same rng seed 0), fraction of families = holdout_fraction
alternatives.temporal: latest holdout_fraction of observations by normalized event time held out (quantile cut); requires time_axis=True

split.counts_note: n = 343035 observations total (44 gbif_tokens chunks); train/test counts printed by prepare.py at cache build

coordinates.storage: self.coords: [n, 4] float32 = stack([lat, lon, elev, tnorm])
coordinates.x: column 0 = latitude in decimal degrees (raw, unnormalized)
coordinates.y: column 1 = longitude in decimal degrees (raw, unnormalized)
coordinates.z: column 2 = elevation in meters (0.0 where gbif_elev.npz has no entry)
coordinates.t: column 3 = event time min-max normalized to [0,1] over the dataset's date span (time_span_days records the physical span; unparseable dates -> median); constant 0.0 when time_axis=False (default)
coordinates.kdtree_metric_frame: _frame() converts to km for neighbor search: [lat*111.0, lon*111.0*cos(37 deg reference latitude), elev/50.0, tnorm*time_km (time_km default 50.0, only when time_axis)]

neighbors.structure: scipy cKDTree built over TRAIN observations only, in the km metric frame from _frame()
neighbors.self_exclusion: train queries fetch k+4 candidates and stable-sort self (by global index) to the end before truncating to k, handling duplicate coordinates; test queries the train-only tree so self can never appear
neighbors.stored_as: self.neighbors: [n, 24] int64 tensor of global train-row indices, for every row (train and test); test rows' neighbors are always train rows
neighbors.what_neighbors_carry: batch() returns neighbor coords (coords[ci]), manifold_positions {biological: phylo[cls[ci]]} (neighbors' evolutionary positions), and neighbor_values {identity: cls[ci], vision_dino: dino[ci]}
neighbors.spatio_temporal: with time_axis=True the 4th KD-tree dim is tnorm*time_km (default 50 km per unit normalized time), so space dominates and recency breaks ties

raw_imagery: No raw images on disk under data/deepcal — only precomputed embeddings. Ground photos exist solely as pooled DINOv2 (1024-d) and BioCLIP (768-d) vectors in gbif_tokens/*.npz; aerial/satellite imagery exists solely as DINOv3-SAT493M pooled vectors (gbif_naip_tokens) and Clay v1.5 Sentinel-2 embeddings (gbif_clay_tokens.npz). No jpg/png/tif archives are present; prepare.py downloads only this pre-processed cache (deepcal_data.zip from https://portal.nersc.gov/cfs/m5239/deepcal).
